payment.title: Payment
payment.description: You can pay for your order in full before it is shipped. Payment upon receipt at a Nova Poshta branch is also available. Nova Poshta charges a money transfer fee for cash on delivery. A partial prepayment may be required for cash-on-delivery orders. The amount of the prepayment is agreed upon when the order is confirmed.

terms.title: Delivery time
terms.description: The dispatch and delivery time depends on the delivery method and destination.
